abstract: The effect of Tamoxifen (TAM) on tumor growth was investigated experimentally using ovarian dysgerminoma serially transplanted into nude mice. The mice were divided into two groups according to estrogen receptor (ER) content of initially transplanted tumor; groups TAM-A and -B indicated ER rich and ER poor tumor, respectively. Their own control (CNT) was included in each group. After TAM treatment, the tumor size of TAM-A and -B groups was 150 fold and 350 fold that of initial tumor respectively, while that of group CNT was over 500 fold, suggesting that a strong anti-tumor effect of TAM was exerted especially on ER rich tumor. Histological changes following tamoxifen treatment such as a decline in the size of tumor cells and nuclei as well, and a decrease in the mitotic index were observed only in the TAM-A group. The concentration of ER and progesterone receptor (PR) in the cytosol of these tumors were measured. The ER levels in the initial tumor tissue of TAM-A and -B were 14.7 and 3.3 fmol/mg protein, respectively. The significant increase in PR content in TAM-A following TAM administration obviously indicated a so-called TAM-dependent PR induction effect. These results indicated that ovarian cancer containing ER, even though it originated from germ cells, would be responsible for antiestrogen therapy.
abstract_ja: ヒト卵巣ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）を継代移植したヌードマウスを用いて、タモキシフェン（TAM）の腫瘍増殖への効果を実験的に検討した。マウスは初回移植腫瘍のエストロゲン受容体（ER）含量により2群に分け、ER高値の腫瘍群をTAM-A群、ER低値の腫瘍群をTAM-B群とした。各群に対照（CNT）を設けた。TAM投与後、TAM-A群およびTAM-B群の腫瘍サイズは初回腫瘍の150倍および350倍、対照群は500倍を超えた。このことから、特にER高値の腫瘍に対して強い抗腫瘍効果が発揮されたことが示唆された。TAM-A群においてのみ、腫瘍細胞および核の縮小、核分裂指数の低下といった組織学的変化が観察された。腫瘍のERおよびプロゲステロン受容体（PR）濃度を測定したところ、初回腫瘍組織のERレベルはTAM-A群で14.7 fmol/mg蛋白、TAM-B群で3.3 fmol/mg蛋白であった。TAM投与後、TAM-A群でPR含量が有意に増加し、いわゆるTAM依存性のPR誘導効果が明らかに示された。これらの結果から、胚細胞由来であってもERを有する卵巣癌は抗エストロゲン療法の対象となりうると考えられた。
